piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Minutes record who spoke, not who agreed.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I owe people an apology, and you can print that.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'm sorry. That's not who I want to be.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: The microphone is passed along the aisle. {name} is next, holding a page of notes.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: The line for the microphone runs to the back wall. {name} reaches the front first.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: {name} takes the microphone and asks about {issue}.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: {name} has come to say something about {issue}.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: {name} wants to hold you to what you said about {issue}.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: {name} was nodding at your answer about {issue}, and stands to ask for more.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You skipped {issue}. {name} doesn't let it go.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: {name} is back at the microphone about {issue} and isn't sitting down.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: What's the town's plan for {issue}? Give me a straight answer.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Is anyone at city hall even looking at {issue}? It doesn't feel like it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I took the evening off to be here for {issue}. You just told me it wasn't worth it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Tell me why you're against {issue}. Give me one reason I'd accept.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Thank you for backing {issue}. What do we do next?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You said yes to {issue} in front of everyone. What's the first step?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That's what I hoped to hear about {issue}. Will you sign your name to it?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: If you mean it about {issue}, I'd like a date.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: My office has a file open on it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I started on it last month.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I have to move on. Others are waiting.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That's all I can say here.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Call my office tomorrow and ask for me by name.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Stop by after this. I'll stay as long as it takes.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I wish I had more time. I don't.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I hear you, and I have to take the next question.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: So why did you tell us otherwise?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Then what changes?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I appreciate you listening.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I didn't expect you to listen. Thank you.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You'll see me here again.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'm not going anywhere.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Fine, I'll do it. One hearing.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: All right. Put it on the calendar. I'd rather have the argument in the open.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You've worn me down. I'll set the date.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Loud enough that I could hear it from the parking lot.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: The sound guy turned the mic down because the room didn't need it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Louder than I've ever heard that hall get.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: All right, I got you. Rest up.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Of course. You've been on your feet all day.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: No problem. Call me when you're up.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: All right. I'll say it at the start of the meeting, to your face.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You're right. I'll stand up and say it in front of everyone.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Fine. At the meeting, out loud, so everybody hears it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Then go now. You'll have my help, win or lose.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: All right. If you're going, go all the way. I'll be in your corner.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Then go. I'll make the calls I can.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Take a message, and tell {opponent} I'll call back as soon as I'm off the stage.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: If {opponent} calls, I want to know the second it happens.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Write down the number and tell them I'll call as soon as I can.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Fair enough. At least you were honest about it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: All right. Then I'll take it to the state myself.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I get it. I'd rather hear that than a promise.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: We've looked at the field, and you're the one we want for {office}.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: {office} is open, and the party thinks you can win it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Don't make me regret asking.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: The party remembers who steps up and who doesn't.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'll run if the party puts real money in.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I want a say in how the campaign is run.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I've already been talking to people about it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You're not the first to ask. I'm leaning yes.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I heard from {source} that you told someone no.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: {source} says you've been telling people you're out.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: We don't have another candidate. Think about what that means.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That's a lot to walk away from. Are you sure?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You'll have the party's full backing. I'll see to it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Perfect. This is exactly what we've been wanting.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Ask me again when I've had time to think.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I don't answer that in a hurry.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I need to talk to my family before I say yes or no.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Give me a few days. I have people at home to ask.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: The deadline isn't going to move for us.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: After the filing deadline, it's too late for anyone.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Not this cycle. I've got too much going on.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'm flattered, but the answer is no.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'd rather keep my reasons to myself.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That's between me and my family.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Home is stretched thin right now. I can't add this.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I don't think my family could take the strain.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Have you told them how much this matters?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Families come around. Have you asked them again?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Is there anything I can help with?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Is it something the party can fix?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: We're short on hands this weekend.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I need a number for Saturday, if you can give me one.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Whatever you've got. Mostly door to door.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Put me where you're shortest.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: The office has the schedule. Check with them.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I don't have the list. Try the office.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: See you Saturday.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'll hold your spot for Saturday.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Take a night off. You earned it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Rest up. We need you Saturday.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'll still be at dinner. I promise.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: This won't change who we are at home.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Okay. I'll keep it off your plate.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: All right, I got you. I'll take care of it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You're right. I should have said something sooner.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I know. I was afraid you'd say no.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Please don't spin me. I want the real answer.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Say it plainly. I can take it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: This isn't over. We'll come back to it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'm not finished with this conversation.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Tell me what you decide. Don't let me hear it from someone else.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Come find me when you've thought it through.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'm not asking you to carry this alone.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Whatever it takes, we do it as a team.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: What made you decide?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: What happened that made you want this?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: All right. I'm trusting you on that.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Okay. But I want to hear it from you first.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Good. I can plan around that.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That's fair. Let's try it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I appreciate that more than you know.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That makes it easier. Thank you.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: If anyone can do it, you can.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I've seen what you do when you care about something. People should see it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'll cook on the nights you're out.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'll drive you around. I won't give speeches.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Okay. But I get to be there when you tell people.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: All right. I'm in. Tell me what you need.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Your support is what I needed most.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I wasn't sure you'd be with me. I'm glad you are.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: {office} needs someone who'll show up. I think that's me.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I've thought about {office} for a long time. I'm ready.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I could use your help. You pick how.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'd like you with me at the events.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'm worn out. Let's pick this up tomorrow.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Let's talk about it tomorrow, once we've both cooled off.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I need some air before I say something I regret. Five minutes.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Give me some time. I'll find you later.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Okay. Take your time.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Go. But we do come back to this.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Another late night at the office. {name} is still up, with the lights low.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: The kitchen is quiet except for {name}, sitting at the table, waiting.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: It's late when you get in. {name} looks up from the couch and doesn't say anything yet.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: The porch light is still on. {name} sits at the table, not eating.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Oh, hey. You made it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Hey. Long day?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: It feels like we lost you the day you got the seat.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Everyone asks where you are. I don't know what to tell them.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'll clear my schedule this weekend. You have my word.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'll set one night a week that's ours. No exceptions.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: It's temporary. It'll settle down.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Everyone in this job goes through it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I don't need an apology. I need you at the table.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You've said sorry before. Show me.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'm not angry. I just miss you.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: The house is too quiet without you in it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: This conversation isn't finished.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: We're going to talk about this properly.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'm tired. Let's talk after we've both slept.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I'm going to turn in. Think about what I said.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Thank you for seeing it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That's all I wanted you to say.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I want something I can plan around.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: A promise is easy. Tell me which days.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Thank you for waiting up. You didn't have to.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That smells good. Thank you.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Come in and sit. I'll get it started.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Take your coat off. You look worn out.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I saved you some. It's on the stove.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Eat something. Then tell me about it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Fine. We'll talk when you're ready.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Go on, then. I'll be here.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You carried me through this. Thank you.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You stood by me the whole way. I won't forget it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Fair. I'll keep my feet on the ground.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Don't worry. You'll make sure of that.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Promise you'll still come home for dinner.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Remember who was here before the votes.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: You earned some real sleep. Go.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Rest. The real work starts soon enough.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Brace yourself. The calls are about to start.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Enjoy this. Soon enough it's all business.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: People keep calling. Everyone wants a minute with you.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Your phone lit up three times while we talked.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Give me a second. It's a lot.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I want to catch my breath.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Take your time. I'll be right here.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Go breathe. We're not going anywhere.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Then give me one evening a week, no phones.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: I want a standing night. Just us.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: When does it get easier?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Will it ever slow down?
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Say it to the volunteers too. They gave up weekends for you.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Don't forget the ones who stood out in the cold with clipboards.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: We'll see how thankful you are when you're buried in meetings.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Thanks are easy today. Ask me in a month.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That's the speech. Now tell me what it costs at home.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Good. But I need to hear what changes for us.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: That's a promise I'll remember.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Keep saying it. I'll keep believing it.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Talk is cheap. Show me in a few months.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Let's see what you do when it's hard.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Message taken. Go.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)

piece.text: Done. Go enjoy this.
piece.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (night: story)
